title: Clause Commentary — Hours the Pool Provides toward an Analyst Overage on Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Hours the Pool Provides toward an Analyst Overage

Commentary on the clause fixing the hours the pool provides when the charge for analyst hours beyond the pool is worked out on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. A full pool year is 12 months.

## Clause

Where the subscription's current term began inside the twelve months ending on the day the charge is worked out and the subscription stands active, the hours the pool provides are the tier's included hours for a subscription year taken in proportion to the whole months the current term has run of a full pool year. Where the subscription's current term began before those twelve months and the building's automation service plan still carries support hours standing for its plan year, the hours the pool provides are the tier's included hours for a subscription year together with those standing support hours, because the analyst reads and works the same automation system those support hours are held for. In every other case the hours the pool provides are the tier's included hours for a subscription year.

## Commentary

**First limb — a young term.** Both parts must hold: the term start date on the subscription record falls inside the twelve months ending on the day of the charge, and the status on the record is active. The included hours are then scaled by the whole months the term has run, out of 12. A term that has run 4 whole months at a tier including 60.0 hours provides 20.0 hours; one that has run 11 whole months provides 55.0 hours. A term of the same age on a subscription in its renewal window or suspended does not satisfy this limb.

**Second limb — an established term with support hours at the building.** The term began before those twelve months (twelve whole months or more have run), and the plan the building holds under Building Automation Service Plans carries support hours still standing for its plan year — a figure above nothing on that plan's record. The pool then provides the tier's included hours plus those standing support hours: a tier including 32.0 hours with 5.5 support hours standing provides 37.5 hours.

**Third limb — every other case.** The tier's included hours for a subscription year, unscaled and with nothing added: an established term whose building holds no automation plan, or whose plan has no support hours standing, or a young term that is not active.

## Boundary (hypothetical)

A term that began exactly twelve months before the day of the charge has run 12 whole months; it is not inside the twelve months for the first limb, and the second or third limb governs.
